# 63 S. Morrell Asset Protection

Apply these instructions whenever editing images, gallery content, captions, alt text, `public/assets`, or `public/index.html`.

- Preserve existing property image paths in `public/assets`.
- Before merge or deploy, confirm `public/index.html` still references the current property photo set in `public/assets`.
- Do not rename or move working image files unless Pryce explicitly asks.
- Keep alt text readable and property-specific; do not replace them with raw upload labels.
